newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romanian industrial output 10.2 pct up in Feb.
newsitem.headline: Romanian industrial output 10.2 pct up in Feb.

text.p: Romania's industry saw a sharp recovery in February, up 10.2 percent from January, when it dropped by 7.3 percent, the National Statistics Board (CNS) said on Friday.
"February's rebound, after two months of lower output, was led by a sharp rise in the manufacturing sector," CNS president Pavel Wagner told a news conference.
Manufacturing industry rose by 12.3 percent last month, when the extractive sector was 5.8 percent up. Output in the power sector saw a 4.3 percent drop from the previous month.
Industrial output stood at 9.05 trillion lei in February, with the two-month figure at 16.3 trillion, or 16.5 percent up from January-February 1996.
Inventories accounted for 65.1 percent of February's production, down from 68.5 percent the previous month.
Some 20 percent of last month's output was exported, while productivity per hour went up by 6.0 percent from January.
Industry employed 2.496 million people at end-February, 11,200 less than the previous month.
ROMANIAN INDUSTRIAL OUTPUT FEB 97 JAN 97 FEB 96
NOTE: Figures were adjusted according to the number of working days.
